    1                                                module i3c_bit_engine (
    2                                                  input   wire        clk,
    3                                                  input   wire        rst_n,
    4                                                  
    5                                                  // from higher level FSMs
    6                                                  input   wire        valid,    // new high-level command available
    7                                                  input   wire        rd_wr,    // 1: read; 0: write
    8                                                  input   wire  [7:0] tx_data,  // byte to be sent
    9                                                  output  reg   [7:0] rx_data,  // byte to be byte to be received
    10                                                 input   wire        arb_mode, // for DAA
    11                                                 input   wire        s_r,      // indicates repeated start
    12                                                 input   wire        push_pull,// 1: push-pull; 0: open-drain
    13                                               
    14                                                 // PHY / SDA interface
    15                                                 input   wire        scl_i,    // sampled SCL input (from sampler)
    16                                                 input   wire        sda_i,    // sampled SDA input (from sampler)
    17                                                 output  reg         sda_o,    // drive value (0/1) when sda_oe=1
    18                                                 output  reg         sda_oe,   // 1=drive, 0=tri-state (OD high)
    19                                               
    20                                                 // Status / error reporting
    21                                                 output  reg         busy,     // bit engine is performing a transfer
    22                                                 output  reg         nack,     // a NACK was observed
    23                                                 output  wire        txn_done, // transaction done (pulse),
    24                                                 output  reg         start_done,
    25                                                 output  reg         stop_done
    26                                               );
    27                                               //assign sda_i = sda_oe ? sda_o : 1'b1; // debug 
    28                                               
    29                                               // FSM encoding 
    30                                               localparam [2:0]
